text.tspan: Estimated gross national income (GNI) per capita, males vs. females 2023
Gross national income measures the total income earned by residents of a country, including income earned
abroad. These figures are estimates that split total GNI by sex according to wage gaps and each sex's share of
the labor force, divided by each sex's population. This data is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs
Gross national income per capita (female) (international-$ in 2021 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
Gross national income per capita (male) (international-$ in 2021 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)

tspan.tspan: This data is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices.
